expectation.note: Months without a fifth Sunday are skipped. Silent clamping to the last Sunday is a conformance failure and is observed.

normative_evidence.note: a month without a 5th Sunday simply contributes no instance; the RFC never clamps
normative_evidence.quote: If the BYDAY rule part is specified with a numeric value ... it MUST only be used in conjunction with either the MONTHLY or YEARLY 'FREQ'

rationale: Directly paired with CRON-EXT-007 (SUN#5). Both grammars specify skip; both have implementations that clamp; a user who wanted 'last Sunday' gets a schedule that fires 5 times a year in one engine and 12 in another.
title: BYDAY=5SU in months that have only four Sundays
